summary: B&G Foods filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026 announcing the sale of its B&M baked beans and brown bread brand and Joan of Arc canned bean brand to McCall Farms, Inc. Terms were not disclosed; no price, premium, or close date provided. Management framed the divestiture as portfolio simplification and deleveraging, with net proceeds earmarked to repay long-term debt. No advisor or board recommendation named. The transaction removes two legacy shelf-stable brands from B&G's portfolio. Watch for disclosed proceeds and leverage reduction in subsequent filings.
